query:
-- Fix Alabama: Add runoff candidates (R: Moore vs Hudson, D: Wess vs Larriett)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Everett Wess', candidate2_name = 'Barry Moore',
    notes = 'R Runoff Jun 16: Barry Moore (39.2%) vs Jared Hudson (25.6%). D Runoff Jun 16: Everett Wess (39.6%) vs Dakarai Larriett (29.1%). Open seat — Tuberville running for governor.'
WHERE state_code = 'AL';

-- Fix Georgia: Add R runoff candidates (Collins vs Dooley, Ossoff D uncontested)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate2_name = 'Mike Collins',
    notes = 'R Runoff Jun 16: Mike Collins (~40.5%) vs Andrew Dooley (~30.2%). Jon Ossoff (D) is uncontested. Open seat — Warnock not running.'
WHERE state_code = 'GA';

-- Fix Oklahoma: Correct primary date from June 24 to June 16
UPDATE senate_races 
SET primary_date = 'June 16, 2026'
WHERE state_code = 'OK';

-- Fix California: Mark as no 2026 Senate race (Schiff serves until 2030)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET status = 'Scheduled', 
    candidate1_name = 'Adam Schiff (incumbent, not up in 2026)',
    candidate2_name = NULL,
    notes = 'Adam Schiff won in Nov 2024, serves until Jan 2031. No 2026 Senate race in California.',
    primary_date = NULL
WHERE state_code = 'CA';

-- Fix Louisiana: Add runoff candidates
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Shawn Davis',
    candidate2_name = 'Julia Letlow',
    notes = 'R Runoff Jun 27: Julia Letlow (~44.8%) vs John Fleming (~28.3%). D Runoff Jun 27: Shawn Davis (~47.4%) vs Karla Crockett (~26.3%). Open seat — Cassidy eliminated in primary.'
WHERE state_code = 'LA';

SELECT state_code, state_name, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status, primary_date, notes 
FROM senate_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('AL', 'GA', 'OK', 'CA', 'LA')
ORDER BY state_code;
